column3: Kuroneko Route · Late-night Lovers' Talk
Well then, it's about time to give Kuroneko a call...
I'm currently unable to answer your call...
So... she's not answering after all...
Ah, what should I do?
I thought I'd talk to her, but I got the answering machine instead... since I'm being that serious about it, it'd be better to talk to her directly.
Still, maybe I should just let her know that I'm prepared for anything?
...I'll stop for now and contact her directly tomorrow.
Huh?! I can't believe this!
Kirino's on her phone?
You delusional occult lover!
I won't ever hear you out anymore!!
--Is she talking with Kirino right now?
So, to put it simply, Kuroneko was talking with Kirino, therefore she couldn't answer my call.
After that, I got up and tried to ask Kirino about Kuroneko, but...
I couldn't get anything at all from my little sister, who was still angry.
Guess I'll just tell her anyway.
She's my cute kouhai after all.
Ah...
I know you have something troubling you.
And you're trying to solve this on your own...
But, I wont let you have your way.
I'll definitely have you explain all this, so prepare yourself.
See ya, that's all...
Hmm?
...What are you saying?
Kuroneko? S-So you were listening...
How embarrassing, I think I'll die of shame.
If you're beside the phone... you could've just answered it...
I did ask you what you were saying.
It's a declaration.
I thought I made it clear to you in today's earlier exchange.
Even so, I still want to know.
You're going to ignore my will and forcibly pry your way into this?
Yeah.
That's why dwellers of the mortal world... are uncivilized barbarians, the worst.
I don't care whatever you say. I made up my mind.
Oh really... In that case, I'll say it once more.
Stop getting involved with me, don't ever step into 【My World】 again.
My world?
If you were to continue to tread further...
Be ready to receive appropriate suffering. Physical contact with those of the forbidden land inevitably result in punishment.
I am already prepared for-
This is most inconvenient...
She actually hung up...!
She won't open herself up on the phone. I'll ask her directly when I meet her...
That girl... she better not belittle me when I'm getting serious!
Anyway for now... time to sleep! We'll see tomorrow!
